fieldValues.title: Convention: one filename slug scheme for new package definition files (srs-rust#1209)
fieldValues.decision_question: Which slug scheme should new definition files use, so lifecycle and vocabulary stop diverging from every other definition kind?
fieldValues.context: Problem: srs-rust writes definition files under two slug schemes. Eight definition kinds use package_service::definition_rel_path (non-alphanumerics dropped, spaces to '-'); lifecycle and vocabulary used their own (every non-alphanumeric to '-'), so the same name gives different filenames depending on kind. Why it matters: one way per goal; a reader cannot predict a filename, and tools that derive paths drift. Options and consequences: (A) adopt the shared scheme for new files as a convention, rename nothing, test it in use; (B) enforce at once and rename existing files, which churns every corpus; (C) leave both. Recommendation: A, per the owner's 2026-10-10 principle (a convention is a test until proven, then enforced). Action needed: none now; ratify to keep the convention, or reject to revert PR. Urgency: low.
fieldValues.friction: Two schemes for one job; the question was left open since #1209 was found during #663.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: A. Shared scheme as convention for new files, nothing renamed (chosen). B. Enforce now and rename existing files (rejected: churn, and the owner ruled enforcement comes only after proof). C. Do nothing (rejected: the divergence persists and one-way-per-goal is breached).
fieldValues.key_requirements: New lifecycle and vocabulary files use definition_rel_path. Existing files are found by their index and are never renamed. No enforcement or warning check yet.
fieldValues.decision_statement: New definition files of every kind, lifecycle and vocabulary included, are named by package_service::definition_rel_path. This is a convention, used as a test until proven; enforcement across the board needs a separate later decision.
fieldValues.rationale: Eight of ten kinds already use the shared helper, so converging the two outliers is the smallest change that gives one scheme. The owner's ruling on srs-rust#1209 (2026-10-10) asks for a convention first, proven before it is enforced.
fieldValues.revisit_when: Proving criteria: after 10 new lifecycle or vocabulary files, or 30 days from merge (whichever is later), with zero path-derivation bugs and no request to restore the old slug; then propose enforcement (a warning-level check for the other scheme) as its own decision.
fieldValues.next_steps: Merge the srs-rust change. Count new lifecycle and vocabulary files from the merge. Steward reviews at the revisit date and proposes enforcement or retirement.
